C0298.title: Runtime Detection of CPU-Exhaustion DoS Attacks
C0298.summary: A 2022 IEEE Transactions on Services Computing paper proposed Coda, a framework for detecting application-layer CPU-exhaustion DoS attacks in containers. These attacks use a small number of carefully crafted requests to trigger algorithmic or implementation weaknesses and consume substantial server CPU resources, differing from traditional high-volume denial-of-service attacks.

references.title: Coda: Runtime Detection of Application-Layer CPU-Exhaustion DoS Attacks in Containers
